$comment: +++===+++ 2026-10-21 — Hasan Alizada — Temporary pip-audit exceptions (security baseline A03). Each entry must also be an --ignore-vuln flag of the root `security:audit` script, and expires: backend/tests/test_audit_ignores.py fails after the date or once the package is no longer at the listed version in uv.lock, so an exception can never outlive its reason.

ignores.reason: The fix (Pillow 13.0.0, released 2026-10-16) is younger than the 7-day minimum release age; no 12.x patch exists. Not reachable here: uploads are opened with an explicit format list (avatars PNG/JPEG/WebP, attachments also GIF), so the TIFF, PPM/PGM, EPS and PDF parsers never run; the GIF issue follows a DecompressionBombError, on which the upload is rejected and processing stops. Added 2026-10-22 (HAAL-054): the MSP decoder never runs (explicit format list) and the two TIFF issues are in TIFF writing, while we only save WebP, PNG and JPEG. Also added 2026-10-22: thirteen more ids; EPS, MIC, XBM, IPTC, FreeType, PDF, rank filters, transform and GIF saving are not used, but two are reachable by a signed-in user uploading a file — CVE-2026-112401 (quadratic GIF comment parsing, CPU) and CVE-2026-112399 (APNG canvas allocated before the decompression-bomb check, memory); accepted for one day because no deployment exists yet. Also added 2026-10-22 (HAAL-061): eleven more ids; BMP, SPIDER, EMF/WMF, PDF, TarIO, font drawing and OpenJPEG are not used and later frames are never decoded (seek(0) only), but two are reachable by a signed-in uploader — CVE-2026-96778 (heap overflow when an attachment is re-saved as JPEG: Pillow carries the uploaded ICC profile and comment over) and CVE-2026-96643 (quadratic PNG eXIf parsing in exif_transpose, CPU); accepted until the planned upgrade the next day because no deployment exists yet. Extended by one day on 2026-10-23 (owner decision): 13.0.0 was published 2026-10-16 22:15 UTC and passes the 7-day minimum only at 2026-10-23 22:15 UTC. Upgrade to 13.0.0 on 2026-10-24 and remove this entry.

The fix (certifi 2026.10.19, released 2026-10-19) is younger than the 7-day minimum release age. certifi reaches us only through requests -> pip-audit in the dev group; the application and its image never load it. Upgrade on 2026-10-26 and remove this entry.
